**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200` (exact), any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain — enforced in `worker/src/index.ts`, inside the `origin` function passed to `cors()` (lines ~20-31), checking `origin === 'http://localhost:4200'`, `origin.endsWith('.pages.dev')`, `origin.endsWith('.workers.dev')`.

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that same `origin` function in `worker/src/index.ts` — add another `origin === '...'` or `origin.endsWith('...')` check inside the `if` condition (array entries won't work for wildcards; Hono matches those as exact strings only). See `docs/code/worker/src/index.md` ("Rules & gotchas").
